'''2008 Worlds Team Bill Kafer DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Bill Kafer]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Team Tournament). Sheet title Still the Superstar. Main deck listed with xN notation and lines 45-60 blank on form; expanded from written counts. Abbreviations expanded best-effort.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Bill Kafer]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|Set Your Course For Alderaan]]
* '''Stage:''' Team Tournament
